title: Vero Beach man arrested in explicit deepfake investigation; police fear more victims

reports.title: Vero Beach man arrested in explicit deepfake investigation; police fear more victims

summary:
A 37-year-old Vero Beach man, Peter Solomon Ruma, was arrested and held on a $1 million bond for creating and sharing AI-generated sexually explicit images of women without consent. Police say he used photos from social media and other online sources to make the altered images. A search of his home and devices found evidence. Ruma faces eight charges involving one female victim from June to August 2026, including creating and promoting altered sexual depictions, sexual cyber harassment, and stalking.

Police have identified several additional potential victims who may not know images were made or shared, and they believe Ruma may have done this for years. He has a prior criminal history, including a 2007 arrest for burglary and sex battery on a physically impaired person. The investigation is ongoing, and additional charges could be filed. Anyone with information is urged to contact Vero Beach Police. Federal officials launched TakeItDown.FTC.gov to help victims report nonconsensual intimate images and seek removal.
